minutes.headline: Committee approved posting grant-funded after-school tutoring jobs and heard a first ESSER update; fee survey still unsettled.
minutes.summary: The committee approved minutes, a small line-item transfer, permission to post after-school tutoring positions, the Sizer School report, and policy 5204 on third read. It heard a dyslexia guidance overview, a busing-fee survey update, and the first quarterly ESSER report. Committee reports covered Chapter 70, capital planning, and a much higher TC Passios estimate.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to give permission to post after-school tutoring positions funded by a grant and federal ESSER money.
It accepted the annual Sizer School report and approved policy 5204 on promotion, retention and graduation requirements on third read.
Members heard the first quarterly ESSER update, which reported spending on target and several positions funded by ESSER 2 and 3.
A transportation fee survey update was heard; the survey will be expanded and sent out early next week, with results by Thanksgiving.
Committee reports noted a much higher new-build estimate from TC Passios, and Turkey Hill renovation versus replacement is to go on a future agenda.

why_it_matters: Grant and ESSER money is paying for tutoring and several school positions, and federal funds of this kind run out, so residents may later see those costs move to the town budget, which is mostly taxes.
The busing-fee survey could lead to a vote on fees for students who ride the bus, and the Turkey Hill building estimates bear on a future capital request that residents may be asked to vote on.
